_note: Job type records. Required objective counts are NOT here: mission_graph.JOB_GRAPH owns them (1, 2, 1, 1) and world.md section 4 states the same numbers. Multipliers and Clock starts are DECISIONS section 16's JOB_TYPE_MULT and CLOCK_START. `extraction` is the canonical key; `paydata` is dialogue.md's name for it (section 16 aliases the two). Which types reach the board is campaign.OFFER_TYPES' - v1 offers extraction alone, which is what keeps Phase 1's slice Job always reachable.

extraction.name: Extraction
extraction.act: reach the vault node, take the Paydata device, and leave

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.act: destroy or disable both target devices, then leave

protection.name: Protection
protection.act: keep the VIP alive: escort to the exit, or hold the node

courier.name: Courier
courier.act: carry the package from entry to the drop node, then exit
